text: Training objectives: to cultivate senior professionals with a sense of social responsibility, good professional ethics and scientific literacy, a solid theoretical foundation and skilled professional skills, the ability to apply the theory of computer science and technology, computer software and hardware knowledge to the design and development of complex computer application systems, a strong sense of innovation and engineering practice ability, teamwork spirit and organizational management ability, and international vision and self-learning ability.Main courses: Electronic and Electrical Technology, Discrete Mathematics, Digital Logic and Systems, Object-Oriented Programming, Data Structures, Computer Composition and Structure, Computer Operating Systems, Microcomputers and Interface Technology, Principles of Embedded Systems, Fundamentals of Database Systems, Computer Networks, Principles of Compilation, Software Engineering, Pattern Recognition, Artificial Intelligence, etc.Professional employment prospects: Employment direction: Graduates majoring in computer science and technology can work in large Internet companies, 5G, artificial intelligence and other new infrastructure-related fields, and can engage in research and development, teaching, management and maintenance of computer applications in research institutes, government departments and related enterprises and institutions.
